description.desc_thousand_char: Geep Industries (India) Private Limited (GIIPL), as per the credit rating report, is engaged in manufacturing lighting products and flexible packaging materials. The company is based in Thane, Maharashtra, and has four manufacturing units in Silvassa in Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Baddi in Himachal Pradesh, Chennai, and Guwahati in Assam. As per the company's annual report, the objective of the company is to manufacture and trade in the battery and torch products segment under the brand name of 'Geep' in the Indian subcontinent and also globally through its export department. GIIPL's clientele includes Pi, Trade Kings, Wallace, Synergy Pharma, and Indofil, among others. The company was incorporated in the year 2002 and is based in Maharashtra.
